decisions.statement: The commands are read from the file the service writes rather than assembled.
The panel draws the commands that file has before any change to that file arrives.
The panel draws again when that file is written and at no other time.
A file written while the panel is hidden is kept rather than drawn.
A panel becoming visible with a drawing owed draws the commands the file last said.
The rows the file has are drawn unchanged rather than spelled again.
The rows counted are all the rows.
The commands counted are the rows a caller can run.
The badge counts rows while the description counts commands.
The description counts the rows a filter matched while that filter is there.
A command no namespace reaches is said to Alan once and named on the channel.
No watcher on a source file is registered here.
Nothing here decides a row's appearance.

definition: the Commands panel brought up, and the commands drawn into it from one file
